content:
Maya: Dropped a new key-management mock that groups actions into a single "card" per key to reduce clutter. Figma: https://figma.com/file/card-layout
Omar: Card layout is clean but watch for hit targets. Keep buttons >=44px and ensure keyboard users can reach the kebab menu easily.
Li: Revoke placement: if it's visible on the card it reads too strong. Suggest kebab -> revoke -> confirm modal. Also consider a lightweight toast+undo pattern behind a feature flag.
QA-bot: Quick check: feature flag 'revoke_undo' = off in staging. Backend POST /keys/{id}/undo exists but limited.
Maya: Ok we'll gate undo messaging. New modal copy proposal when flag off: "Revoke API key — this will immediately stop calls and cannot be undone." If flag on: "Undo available for 30s."
Omar: Empty state needs more guidance in the card layout. Proposed title: "No API keys yet" body: "Create an API key to start calling Redwood Inference. Use scopes to follow least privilege." Primary CTA: "Create API key" Secondary link: "Scopes & best practices". Centered with icon.
Li: Accessibility: 1) Ensure modals trap focus and announce status via aria-live; 2) permission chips must have aria-labels like "scope: admin"; 3) test with 200% text size and keyboard-only nav.
design-bot: Contrast check: badge color (#e74c3c) fails 4.5:1. Recommend darker shade or bold text.
Maya: Action list: 1) move revoke into kebab + confirm modal, 2) conditional revoke copy based on flag, 3) center empty state copy with clearer CTAs, 4) update badge color, 5) add a11y checklist to PR template. Will update figma and ping for review.
